answer: A timber beacon post per identity, a 70-credit bond on its serial, one comet sighting per epoch. A comet decay table gives the expected magnitude from perihelion age; auditors recompute it; a 3% miss or reused serial burns the bond. First 33; k-th 33+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,030,000 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-telescope ring fails: a borrowed key mismatches the timber beacon serial. Honest agents pay 33 once and reclaim it after a clean epoch.
